### 1. Scene
A mixed dinner plate with leafy salad, broccoli, roasted vegetables, grilled cheese, sliced roast meat, and a chicken drumstick.

### 2. Vessel
A large, roughly square dinner plate, partly cropped. I’ll approximate it as a **27 cm diameter equivalent**:
**Area = 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm².**

### 3. Items
Visible foods appear to be mixed salad leaves, broccoli, roasted potatoes, zucchini/yellow squash, grilled halloumi, sliced roast pork, and a chicken drumstick. There is a light oil sheen on the cooked vegetables. The potato, cheese, and sliced-meat identifications are somewhat uncertain.

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas represent allocated footprints, avoiding double-counting overlapping foods. Chicken weight estimates the edible meat and skin, excluding bone.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed salad leaves | 23% | 132 × 3 = 396 ml | 0.15 | 59 g | 20 | 12 kcal |
| Broccoli | 13% | 74 × 2.8 = 207 ml | 0.55 | 114 g | 35 | 40 kcal |
| Roasted potatoes | 14% | 80 × 2 = 160 ml | 0.65 | 104 g | 90 | 94 kcal |
| Zucchini/yellow squash | 10% | 57 × 1.5 = 86 ml | 0.65 | 56 g | 25 | 14 kcal |
| Grilled halloumi | 9% | 51 × 1.2 = 61 ml | 1.0 | 61 g | 320 | 195 kcal |
| Sliced roast pork | 7% | 40 × 1.5 = 60 ml | 0.95 | 57 g | 240 | 137 kcal |
| Chicken drumstick, edible portion | 10% | 57 × 1.6 = 91 ml | 0.95 | 87 g | 215 | 187 kcal |
| Visible cooking oil | Shared coating | Approximately 7 ml | 0.92 | 6 g | 884 | 53 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 23 + 13 + 14 + 10 + 9 + 7 + 10 = **86%**. Oil coats existing food rather than covering additional plate area.

### 8. Sanity check
The estimate is **about 544 g of edible food and 732 kcal**, plausible for this substantially covered dinner plate. The leafy pile contributes relatively little weight; cheese, meat, and oil contribute most of the energy.
